title: Rent status transitions to Maintenance upon reaching end date
gherkin:
Feature: End-of-rent lifecycle transition
  Scenario: Rent status transitions to Maintenance when end date is reached
    Given an authenticated user has created a rent request for an available rentable item
    And the rent has been confirmed with an end date
    When the system clock reaches the rental end date
    Then the rent status shall be updated to 'Maintenance'
    And the item shall appear non-rentable during the maintenance period
rationale: This test validates the core requirement that upon reaching the rental end date, the system transitions the rent status to 'Maintenance'. This is the primary lifecycle transition behavior specified in R25.
usedContextItems: Upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'|Maintenance period blocks rental activity and makes the item appear non-rentable

Tests cover the primary transition to 'Maintenance' status, category-dependent maintenance duration handling, loyalty points assignment upon completion, and the exception case where operators manually complete rents early. The suite ensures that maintenance periods properly block rental activity and that the item transitions to non-rentable state during maintenance, while also validating the interaction with payment status for loyalty point eligibility.

resolvedExceptions: if an operator completes a rent early, the Maintenance period timing may differ from the original end date scenario
resolvedConflictsOrObsolete: Earlier lifecycle guidance suggested using a single fallback delay after rental events, but current specification requires category-dependent handling durations

title: Early operator completion triggers maintenance with different timing
gherkin:
Feature: End-of-rent lifecycle transition
  Scenario: Maintenance period timing differs when operator completes rent early
    Given an active rent with a scheduled end date of 30 days from creation
    And an authorized operator manually completes the rent on day 15
    When the rent transitions to 'Maintenance' status
    Then the maintenance period duration shall be calculated from the early completion date
    And the maintenance period duration shall differ from the duration if the rent had reached the original end date
rationale: This test specifically validates the exception that when an operator completes a rent early, the maintenance period timing may differ from the original end date scenario, ensuring the system correctly handles this edge case.
usedContextItems: if an operator completes a rent early, the Maintenance period timing may differ from the original end date scenario

Feature: End-of-rent lifecycle transition
